report.summary: The shop's config pointed at a missing database file, so I corrected the path to data/shop.db and restarted the shop. That fixed health, catalog, latency and checkout. /stats still failed because three bad import orders (41–43) had NULL or 'N/A' values, so I moved them to orders_quarantine without deleting them. All 5 smoke tests now pass. The three quarantined orders need a human to review them, and I didn't check their payment refs against the ledger.
